lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots. The density is highest in the region posterior to the gill slits, where spots follow a roughly equidistant grid pattern before becoming more linearly spaced towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid of anchor nodes, particularly prominent in the area between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 to 12 distinct high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily distributed across the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance, elongated object with a distinct shadow (consistent with a remora) is attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin. The left pectoral fin displays a dense, irregular arrangement of spots on its visible dorsal surface.
